facility_roles.quote: The Beijing campus hosts the Beijing Electron-Positron Collider, the BESIII experiment, the Beijing Synchrotron Radiation Facility

intervals.label: upgrade of BESI to BESII
intervals.note: The upgrade replaced the central drift chamber with a revamped MARK II vertex detector and replaced the main drift chamber and the barrel time-of-flight system.
intervals.quote: BESI operated from 1989 until 1995, when it was upgraded to BESII, and BEPC was also upgraded.

intervals.label: ended with the BEPCII upgrade
intervals.quote: The upgraded BEPC ran from 1998-2004, when a major upgrade to BEPCII was started.

lineage.quote: BESI operated from 1989 until 1995, when it was upgraded to BESII, and BEPC was also upgraded.

name: BES-II
notes: No BESII website exists; no URL is recorded.

summary.plain: The upgraded Beijing Spectrometer, which ran at the upgraded Beijing Electron-Positron Collider from 1998 to 2004. It measured the hadron production ratio R between 2 and 5 GeV and saw a narrow enhancement in proton-antiproton pairs near threshold in J/psi decays.
summary.technical: BESII: BESI upgraded in 1995-97 (CDC replaced by a revamped MARK II vertex detector; new main drift chamber and barrel TOF); operated 1998-2004 at the upgraded BEPC; R scan at 85 energies between 2 and 5 GeV; near-threshold ppbar enhancement in J/ψ → γ p p̄ (2003).
